# chess.js local runtime

Version: 1.4.0
Fixed commit/npm gitHead: ce1ff9e9fc342984ff75ca475ab39f37888cb28a
Read: 2026-11-04. Repository metadata snapshot: 4447 Stars, push2026-08-11, unarchived; popularity is not quality scoring.

Official npm chess.js-1.4.0.tgz SHA1 edc1439492d1a0d7f530ba72b2b5398baece28a1 verified before extraction. No package scripts executed. prepare/build invokes Peggy, TypeScript and Rollup and was not run. No runtime npm dependencies in package.json; no ESM imports/requires in actual dist/esm/chess.js. Copied original ESM bytes unchanged as chess.mjs. Source-map trailer refers to an unshipped map; browser execution does not require it.

Official GitHub contents API at the fixed commit retrieved package.json, LICENSE and src/chess.ts; LICENSE and source bytes match the npm archive exactly. A connector fetch failed first; direct official API succeeded. This is not a git clone/build reproduction.

Original BSD-2-Clause Jeff Hlywa 2025 retained in LICENSE and embedded ESM header. Runtime includes PGN parser generated by Peggy 4.2.0 (header in original ESM). Included full original MIT Peggy2010-2024 notice from official peggy4.2.0 npm archive, archive SHA1 verified; parser compiler and its dependencies were not installed or distributed. No tslib imports/helper header in this ESM. Own loader is only a native module import and window constructor binding.

Platform Chinese wrapper: offline same-screen two players, legal moves/undo/reset/promotion/game status; at most400 half-moves; PGN/JSON exports. No AI, network play, arbitrary FEN/PGN import, clocks, cloud save or legal identity. Unicode pieces use system fonts; appearance varies. Refresh discards the game. No external fonts, images, models or API.
